Name: DrownedBook
FlavorNote: Still legible underwater. The ink learned to swim.

Name: BottledTide
FlavorNote: Hold it to your ear and the library is still drowning.

Name: PearlOfPages
FlavorNote: Every book that was ever lost, pressed into one bead.

Name: BrassGear
FlavorNote: It turns nothing now, and turns it perfectly.

Name: DustmoteOrrery
FlavorNote: The motes orbit a sun I can't see. They keep good time.

Name: FallenStar
FlavorNote: Cool to the touch. It apologised for the dark.

Name: VoidCompass
FlavorNote: Points to wherever you are not.

Name: SingingComet
FlavorNote: One note, held since before there was air to hear it.

Name: UpsideSpoon
FlavorNote: It stirs the ceiling. The ceiling doesn't mind.

Name: RecursiveRecipe
FlavorNote: Step one: prepare the dish from step one.

FlavorNote: A spoonful of the thing behind the door. It's looking back.
